messages.case.user.title: User & Learning Analytics
messages.case.user.problem: Understand where learners progress, disengage, or encounter friction across English-language digital courses.
messages.case.user.context: edX MOOC analytics through the Universitat de València and UPV collaboration, 2025–2026.
messages.case.user.role: Prepared and analysed learner activity and feedback, then connected patterns to course and support decisions.
messages.case.user.analysis: Examined participation, progression, engagement, feedback, early disengagement, and barriers across learning pathways.
messages.case.user.deliverable: Recommendations for course structure, learner support, and workplace-oriented English materials.
messages.case.user.interpretation: The evidence supports user-pathway and learning-design decisions without attributing causal impact.
messages.case.ai.title: Multilingual AI Speech Evaluation
messages.case.ai.problem: Determine whether speech-to-text systems preserve learner errors that matter for oral-language assessment.
messages.case.ai.context: Doctoral research on error-preserving automatic transcription for multilingual learner speech.
messages.case.ai.role: Designed the workflow, processed structured data, compared model outputs, classified discrepancies, and defined review criteria.
messages.case.ai.analysis: Compared confidence, segmentation, error preservation, calibration, measurement quality, and manual-review burden across model configurations.
messages.case.ai.deliverable: A reproducible Whisper/GPT-supported evaluation workflow and practical criteria for model selection and human oversight.
messages.case.ai.interpretation: A transcript can appear fluent while removing the evidence an educator needs; quality therefore depends on the assessment purpose.
messages.case.inspector.title: Evaluation Data Inspector
messages.case.inspector.problem: Give evaluators a fast first view of data structure, completeness, distributions, and group differences before deeper analysis.
messages.case.inspector.context: Independent portfolio application built with synthetic demo data and an in-memory CSV workflow.
messages.case.inspector.role: Designed the product scope, reusable analysis layer, interface, automated tests, guardrails, and deployment documentation.
messages.case.inspector.analysis: Validates input, profiles variables, summarises numeric outcomes, reviews missingness, compares groups, and calculates Cohen’s d for valid two-group cases.
messages.case.inspector.deliverable: A testable Streamlit application with reusable Python analysis and cloud/container deployment paths.
messages.case.inspector.interpretation: The app is designed for descriptive quality review and early exploration, not causal inference.
messages.case.evalcomplin.title: Multilingual Assessment & Validation
messages.case.evalcomplin.problem: Develop assessment evidence that can be interpreted consistently across languages, cultures, and school contexts.
messages.case.evalcomplin.context: Spanish Ministry-funded research with early-childhood and primary-education settings, 2022–2026.
messages.case.evalcomplin.role: Developed instruments, supported fieldwork and teacher training, evaluated measurement quality, and synthesised mixed-method evidence.
messages.case.evalcomplin.analysis: Combined reliability, validity, group comparison, effect sizes, cross-linguistic comparison, language samples, interviews, and teacher evidence.
messages.case.evalcomplin.deliverable: Assessment materials, standardised procedures, documentation, and guidance for educators and research partners.
messages.case.evalcomplin.interpretation: Comparable procedures and contextual evidence are both necessary when interpreting multilingual assessment results.
